note: WHY larger models compound RSI and smaller don't: scale -> correctness-wall crossing -> training gradient -> LoRA drift (by depth) + sustained self-data diversity -> held-out compounding. Re-derived from per-round WHY-RSI probe series.

correctness_wall.claim: Sub-2B almost never cross the correctness wall (C_train=0) -> zero SFT gradient -> drift=0 -> RSI impossible. This is the primary gate.

among_wall_crossers.claim: Among models that DO produce correct kernels, compounders sustain higher generation diversity and larger sustained drift; flat ones show diversity collapse + drift saturation.
